million_row_repeat.controller_source:
"""Repeat current million-row cases, rejecting observed background CPU activity."""
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys,threading,time
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('benches/order_workflow').resolve()))
import compare
out=compare.OUTPUT
report=json.loads((out/'current-results.json').read_text())
binaries={'rust':compare.ROOT/'target/release/examples/order_workflow',
          'cpp':out/'cpp/gd_order_workflow',
          'cpp_simd':out/'cpp/gd_order_workflow_simd'}
paths={str(p) for p in binaries.values()}

def background():
    snapshot=subprocess.run(['ps','-axo','pid,pcpu,comm'],check=True,text=True,capture_output=True).stdout
    busy=[]
    for line in snapshot.splitlines()[1:]:
        fields=line.strip().split(None,2)
        if len(fields)==3 and float(fields[1])>60 and fields[2] not in paths and Path(fields[2].strip('()')).name not in {'order_workflow','gd_order_workflow','gd_order_workflow_simd','ps'} and not Path(fields[2].strip('()')).name.startswith('gd_order_workfl'):
            busy.append(line.strip())
    return busy

def invoke_idle(binary,workers,stage,index):
    while True:
        while background(): time.sleep(3)
        activity=[];stop=threading.Event()
        def monitor():
            while not stop.is_set():
                busy=background()
                if busy: activity.append({'utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'processes':busy})
                stop.wait(0.5)
        thread=threading.Thread(target=monitor);thread.start()
        try:
            result=compare.invoke(binary,out/'current-million.sqlite',workers,stage,5,index)
        finally:
            stop.set();thread.join()
        if not activity: return result
        result['background_activity']=activity
        report['excluded_measurements'].append(result)
        print('Repeating invocation after observed background CPU activity:',stage,workers,flush=True)
        time.sleep(3)

if 'million_row_repeat' not in report['metadata']:
    old=[m for m in report['measurements'] if m['rows']==1000000]
    report['measurements']=[m for m in report['measurements'] if m['rows']!=1000000]
    report['excluded_measurements']=[dict(m,exclusion_reason='Million-row cases replaced as a complete set after observed background CPU bursts') for m in old]
report['metadata']['million_row_repeat']={
    'utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'command':'python3 target/order-workflow/repeat-current-million.py',
    'method':'Same checked-in compare.invoke and standalone drivers; 3 rotated rounds, '
             '5 samples plus warmup. Background ps CPU checks every 0.5s; benchmark processes '
             'excluded from checks. Wait while another process exceeds 60% of one CPU; '
             'discard and repeat an invocation if such activity is observed. No sanitizer.',
    'fixture_sha256':hashlib.sha256((out/'current-million.sqlite').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
}
cases=[('import',1,'native'),('prepare',1,'native'),('prepare',1,'sorted')]
cases += [(stage,w,'native') for stage in ['variants','complete'] for w in [1,2,4,8]]
for stage,workers,index in cases:
    if sum(m['rows']==1000000 and m['stage']==stage and m['workers']==workers and m['index']==index for m in report['measurements']) == 9:
        continue
    for n in range(3):
        order=list(binaries.items());order=order[n:]+order[:n]
        for name,binary in order:
            result=invoke_idle(binary,workers,stage,index)
            result.update(round=n,implementation=name)
            report['measurements'].append(result)
    (out/'current-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
    print('Repeated million-row case:',stage,workers,index,flush=True)
report['metadata']['million_row_repeat']['finished_utc']=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
report['metadata']['thermal_state_after']=compare.text(['pmset','-g','therm'])
(out/'current-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Current comparison complete; all accepted million-row invocations passed CPU activity checks.',flush=True)
